review.identity: Reviewed against selected canonical original: same face, brown oval eyes, watercolor texture and species markings; rabbit red beret/pink fur or Tora orange stripes and curled tail preserved.
review.style: Light and dark composites inspected at full source resolution; warm brown contour and watercolor fill retained. No source painting, alpha cleanup or per-pose scaling.
review.alpha: RGBA source transparency and alpha8 cell margins passed all 27 exact cells; no clipping or empty frame. Alpha128 used for anatomy only; original feather/edge alpha retained.
review.motion: All 27 distinct key poses inspected. Blinks, pop, think/aha/oops/retry, clap pair, 4 wave states, celebration ready/air/land, seat/stretch/stand and gaze states present. nod_down has limited range; GIFs are discrete key-pose reviews, not certified continuous animation.

pixel_processing: Lossless exact cell crops only. No repainting, alpha cleanup, contour edits or source rescaling.
